svg.text: mcp.dorinda.ai — three callers, three outcomes (permissive edge, fail-closed app)
✅ OpenAI connector (real cert, chains to OpenAI CA)
TLS completes → edge verifies chain → forwards X-Client-Cert-Leaf + X-Client-Cert-Chain-Verified: true
app re-parses the leaf itself → SAN == mtls.prod.connectors.openai.com → chain verdict true
TLS completes WITHOUT a cert (this is why the mode is ALLOW_INVALID_OR_MISSING — REJECT_INVALID broke the Create-plugin flow once)
/.well-known/* served publicly · but POST /mcp → app sees no cert
🕵️ Forged cert (right SAN, self-signed — anyone can mint one)
TLS completes (permissive edge) → chain verification FAILS → edge forwards NO leaf, no verdict
app: missing cert/verdict = failure, never success · proven live 2026-07-30 with a real forged cert

Design rule: the edge is permissive so discovery works; the APP is the enforcement point and fails closed. Traefik did this at the handshake; GCP moves it one layer up — same outcome, verified by verify-mcp-edge.sh (5/5).
